mapper.sql: id, name, normalized_name, description, status, error_message, cleanup_attempt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sv_knowledge_base (name, normalized_name, description, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{normalizedName}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sv_knowledge_base ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sv_knowledge_base SET cleanup_attempt = cleanup_attempt + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DELETING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sv_knowledge_base WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DELETING'
